author: Mark Atwood
text: HUMAN DECISION NEEDED: yellow_zone_probabilistic vector (HL1, count=100 -> 'probabilistic') contradicts budget_hl1_accept_within (count=199 -> 'relay') under any deterministic rule of count alone, and the file carries no RNG field. Options: (a) intended semantics is a keep-probability function of usage ratio with seeded rng per vector — provide formula+seeds; (b) 199->relay is the error and yellow zone spans [budget/2, budget); (c) drop the yellow vector. Implemented meanwhile: broadcast_limit.py with tiered budgets (200/100/30/10), inclusive accept at budget boundary, hard drop beyond, per-sender independence, hourly rolling window, 2h idle expiry. 22 tests pass; yellow case skipped pending decision.
